GOOD TO KNOW

COMMON
QUESTIONS.

Anything else on your mind?

ASK TOM →
Is State Line Gym open 24/7?+

Yes. Members receive 24/7 access to the gym.

How much is a day pass?+

A day pass is $13, available via Venmo or PayPal. Call Tom at 512-987-4440 for assistance.

How do I get gym access?+

After purchasing a membership, you will receive an email with your unique door code, generally within an hour or two. Call Tom if you need access sooner.

What equipment is available?+

The gym has 8 racks, specialty bars, free weights and equipment for powerlifting, weightlifting and strength training.

Can I bring a personal trainer?+

Contact Tom to discuss personal training and facility access before your visit.

Can independent trainers work with clients here?+

Yes. Flexible facility-use arrangements may include per-month, per-week or per-session options. Trainer facility use may be free when clients are State Line Gym members. Contact Tom to confirm your arrangement.

Where is State Line Gym located?+

720 Bastrop HW, Unit 110, Austin, TX 78741.

Is there parking?+

Contact Tom for current parking information before your visit.

Can I tour the gym before joining?+

Call Tom to ask about tour availability and arrange a visit.
